I have read the same sign four times now.
Everything is too slow and it is my own fault.
narcotic: It is wearing off. I can feel exactly where it stops.
I said I would wait until tonight. It is not tonight.
The edges of everything have come back.
Just enough to be level. Not to be high.
I know a place. I do not want to know a place.
gambling: One more slip. The odds are finally right.
I am owed a win. Mathematically, I am owed one.

I could feel it turning yesterday. I could feel it.
Only what is in this pocket. Nothing more than that.

nicotine: I cannot hear anything over wanting a cigarette.
I would take one off the pavement at this point.

My whole head is a lit match with nothing to light.
alcohol: The shaking has started and it does not stop on its own.
I am not right. I have not been right since this morning.
Do not talk to me until I have had something.
The room keeps arriving a second after I do.
caffeine: There is a nail going in behind my eye and it will not stop.
I am no use to anyone. None at all.
I have been awake for hours and asleep the whole time.

narcotic: Every bone I own has an opinion about this.
I am cold and it is not cold out.
I will do almost anything at this point and I know it.
The clock has stopped moving. I have checked it four times.
gambling: I cannot sit still and I cannot say why out loud.
I have counted the money in my pocket eleven times.
There is a race running right now without me in it.
I am going to the shop. I have already decided. I decided hours ago.
